resources.string: Some Bluetooth remotes stop working over Bluetooth after the TV is switched off: the TV keeps them paired but no longer lets them connect. Tick those remotes here. When you press a key on one of them, this app pairs it again and the TV connects it.
No Bluetooth low energy devices are paired with this TV. Pair the remote once in Settings, then come back.
Paired, not connected: waiting for a key press
Before it can watch for your remotes
Allow location: Android only shows Bluetooth devices to an app that may use location. The app never reads where the TV is.
Turn on location in Settings > Privacy > Location.
Turn on Bluetooth in Settings > Remotes & Accessories.
